Name: Warding Word
Description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range gains temporary hit points equal to 2d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier, which they lose after 1 minute. Motivator’s Boon. When this spell is cast by a bard, cleric, or petal knight, its d4s become d6s. Sword Saint Bonus. When cast by a sword saint, this spell is treated as being cast one level higher than it would be. This spell is also treated as being on the class spell list(s) of any creature who has at least three levels in sword saint.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell at 2nd level or higher, its target gains 2d4 additional temporary hit points for each level above 1st.
